description: An estimate of cash for the next 30, 60 and 90 days, from records already in the books: today's cash and bank balance, plus open invoices by due date, minus open bills, recurring expenses and loan payments. It lists the next expected movements too, and lowCash: the first day projected cash falls below the owner's floor (or below zero when none is set), with the lowest point. Not a prediction of new sales or new spending: say so when you quote it.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.
